svg.title: The jPipe refine operator, shown abstractly
svg.desc: On the left, a gold base justification whose leftmost evidence node is ringed with a maroon dashed outline and marked hook, and below it a separate maroon detail justification. Both send symmetric arrows into a chip labelled refine. On the right, the refined result: the base is unchanged except that the hooked evidence node has been replaced by the whole maroon argument, ringed by a matching dashed outline. Children gather onto short rails before a single arrow rises into the strategy above.
